name: Matbench: Benchmark for Predicting Materials Properties from Structure
description: Matbench is an established, rigorously curated machine learning benchmark for predicting physical, thermodynamic, electronic, and mechanical properties of solid-state materials directly from crystal structure or chemical composition. Created by the Materials Project, it comprises 13 standardized benchmarks spanning 133,889 materials calculations drawn from experimental measurements and density functional theory (DFT), evaluated with a strict 5-fold nested cross-validation protocol.
